name: lighthouse
description: Monitor business metrics from your data warehouse and get Slack or email alerts when they move.

interface.longDescription:
Lighthouse watches the business metrics that live in your data (Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres, SQL Server, Mixpanel and more) and alerts your team in Slack or email when something changes.

With Lighthouse in ChatGPT you can build a metric from a plain-language goal, test and backtest it before it goes live, investigate an alert and acknowledge or resolve it, fix a failing metric, tune a noisy threshold, explore your tables and data sets, and connect new sources through a secure Lighthouse link so credentials never pass through the chat. Admins can also manage members, invitations and business groups.

You sign in with your Lighthouse account and pick one organization. ChatGPT can only do what your own Lighthouse role allows. Admins can pause agent access for the whole organization, and every user can disconnect from Settings, API & Agents in Lighthouse.

Requires a Lighthouse account.
defaultPrompt: Use Lighthouse to show which of my metrics are alerting right now.

positive.prompt: List my Lighthouse metrics and tell me which data source each one uses.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the metrics in the Lighthouse Demo organization with their names, status and data source.

positive.prompt: Show me how the Lighthouse metric "Orders Drop vs 7-Day Average - Last 24h" is configured.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows that metric's query and data source, schedule, alert threshold and notification settings.

positive.prompt: Which Lighthouse metrics have segments matching their alert right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the metrics with active matches and the segments that matched, or says none are matching.

positive.prompt: How has the Lighthouse metric "Installs Drop By Country - Yesterday" changed over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes that metric's daily values for its main countries over the last 30 days, the days it met its alert threshold, and any notable changes.

positive.prompt: What data sources and data sets are connected in Lighthouse, and which columns does the first data set have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the connected data sources and data sets and the columns of one data set.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to London next Tuesday.
Show me the metrics of another company that uses Lighthouse.
Delete everything in my Lighthouse account.

publication.release_notes: First release of the Lighthouse plugin for ChatGPT: browser sign-in to the hosted Lighthouse MCP server, tools to read, test and manage metrics, data sources, alerts and members, and skills for building metrics, investigating alerts, fixing failing metrics, tuning alert noise, exploring data, connecting sources and managing members.
